title: The Triumphal Entry and Jesus' Authority

questions.question: When they drew near to Jerusalem and came to Bethphage, Jesus sent two disciples ahead to a village to find what?
options: A donkey tied, and a colt with her
A blind man waiting by the gate
A merchant selling sacrificial doves
A room prepared for the Passover
questions.correctAnswer: A donkey tied, and a colt with her
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:2 (ESV): "saying to them, 'Go into the village in front of you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.'"

questions.question: If anyone asked the disciples why they were taking the donkey and its colt, what were they instructed to say?
options: "The Lord needs them,"
"They were stolen by Rome,"
"We are bringing them to the temple,"
"We have bought them for a denarius,"
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:3 (ESV): "If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, 'The Lord needs them,' and he will send them at once."

questions.question: Jesus riding the donkey fulfilled the prophecy of Zechariah 9:9: "Say to the daughter of Zion, 'Behold, your king is coming to you, humble, and mounted on a...?"
options: donkey, on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden.'
white horse of war.'
golden chariot from heaven.'
lion of the tribe of Judah.'
questions.correctAnswer: donkey, on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden.'
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:5 (ESV): "'Say to the daughter of Zion, "Behold, your king is coming to you, humble, and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a beast of burden."'"

questions.question: What did the crowds spread on the road as Jesus rode into Jerusalem?
options: Their cloaks and branches they cut from the trees
Fine woven tapestries
Rose petals scattered from baskets
Gold and silver coins
questions.correctAnswer: Their cloaks and branches they cut from the trees
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:8 (ESV): "Most of the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, and others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road."

questions.question: What did the crowds going before Him and following Him shout?
options: "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
"Hail, King of the Jews! Conqueror of Rome!"
"Mercy! Save us from the Romans!"
"Holy is the prophet from Nazareth!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:9 (ESV): "And the crowds that went before him and that followed him were shouting, 'Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!'"

questions.question: When Jesus entered the temple, what did He do to those who were selling and buying?
options: He drove them out and overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons
He cursed them with leprosy
He preached a sermon of forgiveness to them
He bought all their goods and freed the doves
questions.correctAnswer: He drove them out and overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:12 (ESV): "And Jesus entered the temple and drove out all who sold and bought in the temple, and he overturned the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who sold pigeons."

questions.question: Jesus quoted the scriptures saying His house shall be called a house of prayer, but the money-changers made it what?
options: A den of robbers
A marketplace of thieves
A cave of harlots
A house of idolatry
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:13 (ESV): "He said to them, 'It is written, "My house shall be called a house of prayer," but you make it a den of robbers.'"

questions.question: When the chief priests and scribes were indignant at the children crying "Hosanna to the Son of David," Jesus quoted a psalm. "Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies you have prepared..." what?
options: Praise
Weapons
Truth
Judgment
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:16 (ESV): "...Have you never read, 'Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies you have prepared praise'?" (Quoting Psalm 8:2)

questions.question: Returning to the city early in the morning, Jesus was hungry and found a fig tree. Why did He curse it to never bear fruit again?
options: Because it had nothing but leaves
Because its fruit was rotten
Because it blocked the road
Because it belonged to a Pharisee
questions.correctAnswer: Because it had nothing but leaves
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:19 (ESV): "And seeing a fig tree by the wayside, he went to it and found nothing on it but only leaves. And he said to it, 'May no fruit ever come from you again!' And the fig tree withered at once."

questions.question: What did the disciples marvel at regarding the fig tree?
options: How the fig tree withered at once
That Jesus was hungry
That it was the wrong season for figs
That Jesus spoke to a plant
questions.correctAnswer: How the fig tree withered at once
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:20 (ESV): "When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, 'How did the fig tree wither at once?'"

questions.question: When the chief priests and elders asked Jesus by what authority He was doing these things, Jesus asked them a question in return about whose baptism?
options: John's baptism, whether it was from heaven or from man
His own baptism
Moses' baptism of the Israelites
Their ritual washings
questions.correctAnswer: John's baptism, whether it was from heaven or from man
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:24-25 (ESV): "I also will ask you one question... The baptism of John, from where did it come? From heaven or from man?"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Two Sons, a man asked his two sons to work in the vineyard. What did the first son do?
options: He said "I will not," but afterward he changed his mind and went
He said "I go, sir," but did not go
He immediately went and worked hard all day
He struck his father and fled
questions.correctAnswer: He said "I will not," but afterward he changed his mind and went
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:28-29 (ESV): "He went to the first and said, 'Son, go and work in the vineyard today.' And he answered, 'I will not,' but afterward he changed his mind and went."

questions.question: Jesus told the chief priests that who will go into the kingdom of God before them, because they believed John the Baptist when the priests did not?
options: The tax collectors and the prostitutes
The Essenes
The Romans and Greeks
The Samaritans
questions.correctAnswer: The tax collectors and the prostitutes
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:31 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'Truly, I say to you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes go into the kingdom of God before you.'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Tenants, the master of the house leased his vineyard to tenants. When the master sent his servants to get his fruit, what did the tenants do?
options: They beat one, killed another, and stoned another
They gave the servants half the harvest
They paid the servants with gold instead
They hid in the mountains until the servants left
questions.correctAnswer: They beat one, killed another, and stoned another
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:35 (ESV): "And the tenants took his servants and beat one, killed another, and stoned another."

questions.question: Finally, the master sent his own son. Why did the tenants kill the son?
options: They said, "This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and have his inheritance."
They thought he was a thief in the night
The son threatened to burn down the vineyard
They didn't recognize him
questions.correctAnswer: They said, "This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and have his inheritance."
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:38 (ESV): "But when the tenants saw the son, they said to themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and have his inheritance.'"

key_verse_text: And the crowds that went before him and that followed him were shouting, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"
